name: Sharq Village and Spa, A Ritz-Carlton Hotel
positioning: Beach hotel in Doha designed to emulate a marbled Sheikh's palace, a few steps from the National Museum of Qatar and Souq Waqif (the official name is Sharq Village & Spa, a Ritz-Carlton Hotel)
best_for: Travelers who want a private beach and pools close to Souq Waqif and the National Museum of Qatar
Families wanting a two-bedroom suite and the Ritz Kids program

facts.text: The hotel is a few steps from the National Museum of Qatar and Souq Waqif.
The hotel has three pools and a private beach.
Water sports on the Arabian Gulf include kayaking and stand-up paddleboarding.
The Ritz Kids program offers children's activities.
Families can stay in a two-bedroom suite with private balconies.
All rooms have marble bathrooms with a rainforest shower and a bathtub.
The Royal Villa has a private in-villa check-in and 24/7 butler service.
Private beachfront dinners are served in gazebos.
The fitness center has Technogym equipment.

highlights.text: The hotel is designed to emulate a marbled Sheikh's palace.
Every evening at sunset the lobby hosts a ceremony where staff in traditional attire light the Bakhoor.
Parisa is a sea-view Persian restaurant.
The hotel was recognized with One MICHELIN Key in 2025.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have an airport shuttle to Hamad International Airport.
The pool has a swim-up bar, with drinks enjoyed seasonally.
